A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CEM study and provide readable main text, equations, all 17 tables, all 14 figures, and Appendices A–E. Content displaced by pagination, including Appendix E.5, remains available in v2.

before.justification: v1 reports original image/video generation experiments, quantitative comparisons, ablations, and robustness analyses in Section 4 and Appendices B–E.

after.justification: v2 retains original quantitative and qualitative generation experiments, including the comparisons in Tables 1–3, ablations in Table 4, and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: Offline error modeling, cumulative error approximation, dynamic programming, and plug-and-play deployment remain unchanged. Equations 1–3 and Algorithm 1 specify the same procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions retain MS-COCO2017/DrawBench text-to-image evaluation, VBench text-to-video evaluation, and ImageNet class-to-image evaluation. Appendix prompt-source, resolution/frame, and complex-prompt scenarios are also unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within the corresponding main-text and appendix comparisons. This includes the caching and quantization baselines, L2C and HarmoniCa in Table 16, and the one-step comparisons in Table 17.

E3.justification: Section 4.1, Appendix D.1, and the table headers retain the same metrics, sample counts, sampling steps, acceleration settings, precisions, resolutions, and frame counts. No evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The component ablations, error-definition comparisons, sample-source and sample-count analyses, cost analyses, robustness tests, and qualitative case studies are retained. Repositioned appendix material supplies no new analysis.

E5.justification: Figure 3 retains the same error-distribution and variance reporting, and Table 6 retains the same seed comparisons. No repeated-run information, confidence intervals, or statistical testing procedure is added or changed.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative samples are unchanged throughout. For example, FasterSD+CEM retains FID 19.99 in Table 1, and Hunyuan TaylorSeer+CEM retains VBench 81.24 in Table 2; appendix result entries also match.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations 1–11 are unchanged. Appendix C retains both error-bound theorems and their proofs, together with the dynamic-programming complexity and optimality arguments.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about training-free caching optimization, fidelity improvement, model generality, and quantization compatibility. Minor wording cuts do not change their scientific scope.

C2.justification: Interpretations of content independence, error accumulation, fidelity, and robustness remain unchanged. The conclusion retains the limitations concerning training-based performance and one-step generation, and the appendix applicability discussions are preserved.

D1.justification: v1 promises future code release; v2's abstract supplies a concrete repository address and reports public release. New Appendix A.2 adds a reproducibility statement but says release is still forthcoming and contains an unresolved 'Appendix ??' reference. Implementation settings remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds Sun et al. (2025), Braincognizer, to the opening introduction and bibliography, broadening the background examples of diffusion applications. The positioning against existing acceleration approaches is otherwise retained.

P1.justification: v2 lightly compresses introduction and related-work prose, expands the affiliation, updates the publication header, and adds acknowledgments. Appendix A becomes Statements, adding ethics and reproducibility subsections while retaining the LLM-use disclosure as A.3.

P2.justification: Figures and tables retain their content and designs, but spacing and float placement change. For example, Figure 10 moves from page 27 to page 28 alongside Figures 11–12, and Figure 9 shifts relative to the appendix prose.

improvement.justification: The explicit repository address modestly improves code-access documentation over v1's release promise; the scientific evidence remains unchanged. This benefit is partly offset by the contradictory release wording and unresolved reference in new Appendix A.2. The PDFs alone do not establish the repository's contents or usability.
